hero.title: Your patient account.
hero.sub: Create a safe space to keep your own notes between sessions. Only you can read what you write — not the professional, not us.
hero.alertBody: You can join any appointment just by using the link sent by the professional. The account only exists so your own notes can be saved and available later — without it, they vanish when you close the tab.

stepData.sub: Use the name you'd like to be called by. Everything is editable later.
stepData.passwordNote: Your password derives the key that encrypts your notes. There is no automatic recovery — in the next step we'll show you a seed phrase to keep.
stepData.consent: I accept the Terms of Use and the Data Processing terms (LGPD, Art. 11). I understand that my notes are personal and are encrypted with a key only I control.

stepRecovery.sub: This is the only way to recover your notes if you forget your password. Print it or write it down somewhere safe. We keep no copy.
stepRecovery.confirm: I confirm that I copied and stored my seed phrase in a safe place. I understand that without it and without my password, no one will be able to decrypt my notes.

stepDone.subDefault: Taking you to your personal dashboard…

status.needDisplayName: Tell us what to call you.
status.needConsent: You need to accept the terms.
status.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — please select it manually.

errors.emailInUse: This email is already registered. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: Password too weak. Use at least 10 characters.

download.intro: This is the only way to recover your notes if you forget your password.
download.warn: Keep it somewhere safe. Never share it.
